newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU consumer confidence shows first rise since March.
newsitem.headline: EU consumer confidence shows first rise since March.

text.p: European Union consumers showed a surprising burst of improved confidence in October, the first sign of an upswing in economic sentiment since March, the European Commission said on Tuesday.
"Consumer confidence has gone up for the first time since March, reinforcing the improvement of the overall economic climate," the Commission said.

In its monthly survey of consumers and businesses, the EU's executive also found a better environment in the manufacturing sector, evidenced by rising orders and an improved assessment for future production.
Overall, the Commission's economic sentiment indicator, which combines the views of industry, the construction sector and consumers, showed an increase in all of the EU's 15 nations except for Italy.
